summary: The level is the kernel of reduction to the triangle modulus, which is 𝔟 here; reduction is onto.

steps.claim: Since z or a ≠ 0, nodeLevel is the kernel of reduction from O_E/𝔪 to the triangle modulus, which is 𝔟 = M^{b₁} here; its index is the order of the image, all of GL over O_E/𝔟 (reduction K₀ → GL(O_E/𝔪) is onto and factors).
